verdict.rationale: Statsig documents the Console API as the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI. It is backed by a published, versioned OpenAPI 3.0 spec with a stability guarantee, an in-page live request runner, plus an official CLI and MCP server. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that every UI action has an API equivalent, and explicit documented coverage of non-config surfaces such as analytics, Warehouse Native, and access management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
Statsig keeps the OpenAPI spec for this API version up-to-date.
Statsig guarantees that each version won't break existing usage
